description: This Java class 'Transitions' demonstrates the usage of Android's transition APIs, including scenes and a TransitionManager. It manages scene transitions, both from resource files and dynamic UI changes, within an Android activity.

classes.name: Transitions
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating the use of Scene transitions and TransitionManager in Android.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes scenes and transition manager, sets up the activity layout.

methods.name: selectScene
methods.description: Handles user interaction to transition between different scenes or perform dynamic size changes.

methods.name: setNewSize
methods.description: Adjusts the size of a view dynamically, used during scene transitions.
